posts.title: AI Is a Tool. Using It Well Takes Skill.
posts.description: A response to Rich Hickey's "'AI' is Not a Tool": automation and tool use can coexist, and wielding an LLM well requires skill, feedback, and judgment.

posts.title: Datalevin 1.1.0: State-of-the-Art Performance Across Data Models
posts.description: Datalevin 1.1.0 combines fast durable transactions with leading results on relational, graph, document, and logical workloads. Six charts show the measurements, their scope, and the remaining gaps.

posts.title: AI Coding Has Erased the Supposed Advantage of Statically Typed Languages
posts.description: An argument that AI coding shifts the advantage from static typing toward concise languages, where fewer tokens leave less room for misunderstanding.
